comment: PHASE 2: prove the activation + rollback loop with an UNMODIFIED clone.
Zero patches on purpose. 'apply' therefore means: clone the stock binary into
RAM and bind-mount the identical copy over the stock path, then restart. Because
nothing changes, the running app is byte-for-byte stock - this validates code
execution (the SD 'Do you want to run it?' path), the bind-mount, and the
rollback/reboot path WITHOUT altering the app.
result.sha256 == target.sha256 by construction (a clone of stock).
